items.title: Warrant list
Minutes
Contracts and claims settlements list
Fiscal Year 2024 sidewalk program.
Resolution declaring the acquisition of fee simple right-of-way and temporary construction easement.
Supplement No. 1 with Mehta and Associates, Inc. for CEI services for the Australian Avenue Drainage Improvements.
Resolution approving a tri-party railroad reimbursement agreement with FDOT, and an agreement with FDOT and SFRTA to reimburse maintenance upgrades.
Proportionate Share Agreement with BC Boynton Industrial, LLC for the proposed project BC Commerce Center.
Reappointments of two members to the Palm Beach County HIV Comprehensive AIDS Resources Emergency Act Council.
Amendment No. 1 with Florida Rural Legal Services, Inc. to extend the end date, and Amendment No. 1 with Legal Aid Society of Palm Beach County to extend the end date.

Amendment for Extension with FDOT for the Public Transportation Agreements for Storm Hardening Facility Improvements, CCTV Camera Improvements at PBI, and Design and Construction of General Aviation Federal Inspection Service Facility Improvements at PBI.
FAA Letter Amendment No. 1 to Conduct Noise Compatibility Plan Study at Palm Beach County Park Airport extending the Period of Performance.
FAA Letter Amendment to Conduct Environmental Study at North Palm Beach County General Aviation Airport extending the Period of Performance.
Award Modification Number 00006 with TSA for the Law Enforcement Officer Reimbursement Program, and approve a Budget Amendment.
Change Order No. 3 with Alen Construction Group, Inc. for Repairs to Short-Term and Long- Term Parking Garages 2 and 3 for amount and calendar days.
Amendment No. 1 with RS&H, Inc. for New Aircraft Rescue Fire Fighting Facility Phasing Services at PBI, and a Budget Transfer.
Five Consent to Sublease by Signature Flight Support LLC at PBI.
Unmanned Aircraft System Activity Permit with FPL.
Reappointment of one member to the Contract Review Committee.
Work Order No. 23-011 with Cedars Electro-Mechanical, Inc. for the Delray Health Clinic- Outside Air Unit Replacement project.
Two Capital Improvement Agreements with the Town of Lantana for the Community Sensory Garden, and City of Riviera Beach Sanitary Sewer Lift Stations control panel replacements.
Documents executed in connection with a load made to Oceana Logistics International, Inc.
Loan Agreement with Everglades Townhomes LP.
Amendment No. 002 with the City of Lake Worth Beach for project completion, and Amendment No. 003 with the Village of Palm Springs to extend the performance timeline.
Reappointment of one member to the Construction Board of Adjustments and Appeals.
Work Order No. 3 with Johnson-Davis Inc. for the Gun Club Road Water Main Replacement project and Work Order No. 4 for the Haverhill Road Water Main project.
Change Order No. 5 with TLC Diversified, Inc. for the Improvements to Master Repump Station 9-North project.
Standard Potable Water and Wastewater Development Agreements with W&W XXIV, LLC, with Pebb Atlantic II, LLC and with Principal Development Group, LLC.
Amendment No. 3 with Hazen and Sawyer, P.C. to extend the contract for services.
Change Order No. 3 with TLC Diversified, Inc. for the Lift Station Rehabilitation Project B Bid Package 2 and for a project time extension.
Budget Transfer within the Golf Course Capital Fund to the John Prince Golf Learning Center Lighting Improvements project.
Grant Adjustment Notice, a Budget Transfer, and a Budget Amendment of the John D. and Catherine T. MacArthur Foundation Safety and Justice Challenge Grant.
Acceptance and approval of FEMA Staff for Adequate Fire and Emergency Response Grant Program Agreement, a Budget Amendment, and a request to increase staffing.
Acceptance and approval of FEMA Fire Prevention & Safety Grant Program Agreement, and a Budget Amendment for the purchase of smoke/carbon monoxide alarms.
Standard Agreements with several municipalities for swimming lessons.
Contract with DOH for Environmental Health and Engineering programs.
Rescind an Interlocal Agreement with the City of Lake Worth Beach, approve a replacement agreement and authorize County Administrator and/or designee.
Third Amendment with the City of Greenacres to provide additional phone services.
Second Amendment with Veterinary Emergency Group, LLC for relief veterinary services.
Victim of Crime Act Grant Agreement with the State of Florida, and approve a Budget Amendment.
Contract with Choice to Change, Inc. to provide community service assistance to eligible youth reentry participants.
Subrecipient Agreement for Federal grant funding assistance through FDLE, and approve a Budget Amendment.
Human Trafficking Grant Award, and approve a Budget Amendment.
Fentanyl Eradication Program Interlocal Agreement, and approve a Budget Amendment.
Behavioral Health Response Program Grant Award, and approve a Budget Amendment.
Unidentified Human Remains Program Grant Award, and approve a Budget Amendment.
Victim of Crime Act Award, and approve a Budget Amendment.
Expenditure for additional funds to complete the installation of speed bumps, and approve a Budget Transfer.
Eleven agreements under the NEAT Grant to implement various community improvement projects and initiatives, and delegate authority to the County Administrator and/or designee.

Two Grant Agreements, with Prospect Select Baseball, Inc. for the promotion of the Prospect Select World Invite, and Perfect Game USA, Inc. for the promotion of the Perfect Game Youth Fall Invitational.
Reappointment of one member to the Internal Audit Committee.
Audit Risk Assessment and Annual Work Plan.
Amendment No. 1 with AECOM Technical Services, Inc. for the continued performance of professional planning and design services to the Airport Capital Improvement Plan, and approve a Budget Transfer.
HOME American Rescue Plan Program Award to West Palm Beach Housing Authority, direct staff to negotiate the Loan Agreement and authorize County Administrator and/or designee.
Request to HUD to convert Neighborhood Stabilization Program 1 income to Community Development Block Grant funds, allocation in CDBG conversion funds, a Budget Transfer and a Budget Amendment.

Resolution with FDOT approving Public Transportation Grant Agreement to provide operating assistance for the Port St. Lucie Express Regional Transit Pilot Program, along with a lease for coach bus, and a Budget Amendment.
Agreement to purchase and sale of vacant land located north of Indiantown Road and east of Bee Line Highway, and a Memorandum of Agreement.

Multi-year Small/Minority/Women Business Enterprise utilization report, authorize a two (2) year extension, authorize an updated disparity study, authorize funding, and support an increase in the size standards.
Preliminary reading and permission to advertise to amend Ordinance to Equal Business Opportunity Program.

source_note: Items and titles transcribed from the official agenda (table of contents or order of business). Agendas list what was scheduled, not what was decided; votes are not in agendas.
